backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing the full backend: product CRUD, user profiles, session management, access control initialization, and Amazon product metadata extraction via HTTP outcalls.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing three implemented features—fixing Add Product flow, fixing Edit Product flow, and applying hot-pink button styling—with associated files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON map of frontend source files to short summaries describing each component's purpose, styling approach, and key fixes applied across the React frontend.
frontend/CLOUDFLARE_CDN_SETUP.md: Step-by-step guide for configuring Cloudflare CDN settings (minification, Brotli, caching, image optimization, HTTP/3) to improve performance of the RecomNow India website.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_TROUBLESHOOTING.md: Documents a production deployment failure caused by a missing favicon asset and provides a go-live checklist covering static assets, build verification, routing, service worker, and performance checks.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry point with SEO meta tags, Open Graph/Twitter cards, geo tags, structured data for the organization, resource hints for performance, and inlined critical CSS to eliminate render-blocking.
frontend/PERFORMANCE_ACTION_PLAN.md: Action plan targeting Lighthouse scores of 90+ mobile and 95+ desktop by addressing large JS bundles, unoptimized images, render-blocking CSS, and missing cache headers across phased optimization steps.
frontend/PERFORMANCE_OPTIMIZATION.md: Documents all performance optimizations implemented for the RecomNow India frontend, covering critical CSS inlining, image optimization, code splitting, service worker caching, Core Web Vitals monitoring, and React Query tuning to achieve PageSpeed scores >85.
frontend/public/robots.txt: Standard robots.txt allowing all crawlers and pointing to the sitemap URL.
frontend/public/sitemap.xml: XML sitemap with a single entry for the homepage, marked as daily change frequency and highest priority.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker implementing cache-first strategy for static assets and network-first for HTML/API calls, with versioned caches, pre-caching of critical assets on install, and cleanup of old caches on activate.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that handles client-side routing via history API, lazily loads ProductsPage, AdminPage, and SitemapPage, and conditionally renders the Header, Footer, and PageModal based on the current path.
frontend/src/components/admin/BlogManage: Placeholder admin panel component that displays a notice indicating blog management functionality has been removed.
frontend/src/components/admin/Newsletter: Placeholder admin panel component that displays a notice indicating newsletter management functionality has been removed.
frontend/src/components/admin/ProductMan: Admin UI for full CRUD management of products, including a form dialog for adding/editing products with category selection, pricing fields, and validation.
frontend/src/components/admin/SitePagesM: Placeholder admin panel component that displays a notice indicating site pages management functionality has been removed.
frontend/src/components/AdminLogin.tsx: Admin authentication component supporting both username/password (login and registration with password strength validation) and Internet Identity login, with tab-based UI and error/loading state handling.
frontend/src/components/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin dashboard shell with a sticky header, logout functionality, and tab navigation to switch between ProductManagement, BlogManagement, NewsletterManagement, and SitePagesManagement sub-components.
frontend/src/components/AmazonBanner.tsx: Stub component that renders nothing, serving as a placeholder for a removed Amazon banner feature.
frontend/src/components/BlogPostModal.ts: Modal dialog that displays a static unavailability message, indicating the blog feature has been removed from the current version.
frontend/src/components/BlogTeaser.tsx: A memoized BlogTeaser component that previously displayed blog content but now renders nothing (returns null) as blog functionality has been removed.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer component with brand info, social media links, quick navigation links, legal page links, and a newsletter subscription form.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky site header with logo, desktop navigation links, a 'Shop Now' CTA button, and a responsive mobile hamburger menu.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Full-width hero section with a background image, headline, description, and 'Shop Now'/'View Collections' call-to-action buttons.
frontend/src/components/OptimizedImage.t: A Core Web Vitals-optimized image component using a <picture> element with WebP/PNG fallback, lazy loading, fetchpriority, and aspect-ratio CLS prevention.
frontend/src/components/PageModal.tsx: A modal dialog that displays static content for legal/info pages (Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, Contact Us) based on a pageKey prop.
frontend/src/components/PasswordStrength: Displays a visual password strength bar (weak/medium/strong) with color coding and feedback messages based on password validation results.
frontend/src/components/ProductGrid.tsx: A paginated product listing grid with search, category filtering, price range filtering, and sort options, fetching products via a custom query hook.
frontend/src/components/SocialProof.tsx: Displays a social proof section with customer testimonials rendered as star-rated cards and a rotating ticker of recent purchases that cycles every 3 seconds.
frontend/src/components/Spinner.tsx: Renders an animated SVG spinner icon used as a loading indicator throughout the app.
frontend/src/components/TrustBadges.tsx: Renders a configurable set of trust badge images (e.g., Kolkata-based, Amazon Associates, SSL secure) in either horizontal or vertical layout.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an ICP backend actor instance via React Query, using the current Internet Identity and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts: Zustand store with persistence that manages admin session state including token, username, expiry, and session validity checks.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackendAuth.ts: Provides React Query mutations for user registration, login, and logout against the ICP backend actor, managing session tokens and cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useDebounce.ts: Exports two utility hooks: one for debouncing a reactive value and one for debouncing a callback function, both with configurable delay.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication context provider and hook using DFINITY's AuthClient, managing login status, identity persistence, and delegation validity.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend interactions including CRUD operations on products, user registration/login/logout, and fetching user profile and admin status.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet using Tailwind CSS with a custom gold-and-navy color scheme, defining CSS variables for light and dark modes including semantic tokens and palette scales.
frontend/src/lib/web-vitals.d.ts: TypeScript type declarations for the `web-vitals` module, defining the Metric interface and report handler functions for CLS, FID, FCP, LCP, and TTFB.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider providers.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin page component that handles authentication state (Internet Identity and custom session), showing a loading spinner, error state, access denied message, or the AdminPanel/AdminLogin based on auth status.
frontend/src/pages/ProductsPage.tsx: Simple products listing page that renders a header section and the ProductGrid component within a max-width container.
frontend/src/pages/SitemapPage.tsx: Generates and writes a basic XML sitemap to the document on mount, covering the home and products URLs for the ICP canister.
frontend/src/utils/delayedScripts.ts: Utility that defers injection of third-party scripts (Google Analytics) until 3 seconds after the window load event to improve Core Web Vitals.
frontend/src/utils/passwordValidation.ts: Provides password strength scoring (weak/medium/strong) and validation utilities checking length, character types, and match confirmation.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL query parameters from both regular and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence helpers and a function to remove sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom oklch-based color tokens (gold, navy, pink-hot, sidebar, chart, etc.) and enabling dark mode, typography, container queries, and animate plugins.
frontend/vite.config.ts: Vite build configuration for a React/ICP frontend, setting up path aliases, DFX network environment variables, API proxying, aggressive Terser/LightningCSS minification, and manual chunk splitting for optimal caching.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file for 'RecomNow India' recording known issues (broken add/edit product flows), existing feature fix requests, and pending action items including fixing product management and changing all buttons to hot-pink.
